premarket.market_expectations: Short bias dominates with negative overnight moves in US indices and rising Treasury yields pressuring risk assets. The rupee's strength contrasts with broad dollar index gains, while FII inflows partially offset DII outflows. Brent crude's sharp decline may relieve some inflation concerns, but elevated US yields and weak tech sector performance weigh on global sentiment. Expect defensive positioning as volatility remains elevated despite recent declines.
